meta.method: Each row's score was read from the official NFL scores page or official NFL Game Center page/gamebook named in source_url, on 2026-11-14, and transcribed digit-for-digit. Nothing was inferred; games whose digits the official page did not expose ('Hidden Score' at retrieval) are recorded in hidden_scores with no score values.

official_gamebook_discovery.note: The official NFL Game Center gamebook PDF for each game (linked from the game page) is an authoritative primary source that publishes: final score and quarter lines, scoring plays, official starting lineups (offense and defense), Did Not Play and Not Active lists, game-day weather, officials, and paid attendance. This is the missing official feed for replacement-depth tracking (who actually started) and for per-game official weather. Demonstrated on WAS@NYG 2026 week 10 (gamebook link in sources).
